description: This Java source file defines the EntityBatchIterator class, which implements an iterator to fetch batches of GenericValue entities from a data source. It supports paging through large query results by managing limits and offsets.

classes.name: EntityBatchIterator
classes.description: An iterator class that fetches batches of generic entity values based on an EntityQuery. It handles pagination through limit and offset parameters, providing hasNext() and next() methods for iteration.

methods.name: EntityBatchIterator
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the iterator with the given EntityQuery and sets default limit and offset if not specified.

methods.name: hasNext
methods.description: Determines if there are more elements to iterate over, catching and rethrowing exceptions as RuntimeException.

methods.name: hasNextWithException
methods.description: Checks whether additional batches are available, fetching the next batch if needed. Throws GenericEntityException on error.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Returns the next GenericValue object in the iteration, catching exceptions and rethrowing as RuntimeException.

methods.name: nextWithException
methods.description: Fetches the next element, throwing an exception if none are available.

methods.name: getNextBatch
methods.description: Fetches the next batch of results from the query based on the current offset, updating the internal state.

methods.name: needNextBatch
methods.description: Determines if a new batch of data needs to be fetched based on the current position and batch state.
